name: Sisters of Sigmar

specialRules.name: Sign of Sigmar (Special skill)
specialRules.text: Possessed or Undead opponents lose their first attack in the first round of hand-to-hand combat (down to a minimum of 1).

specialRules.name: Righteous Fury (Special skill)
specialRules.text: The model hates all Skaven, Undead or Possessed warbands and all models in them.

specialRules.name: Protection of Sigmar (Special skill)
specialRules.text: Any spell that would affect her is nullified on a D12 roll of 7+. If the spell is nullified it will not affect any other models either.

specialRules.name: Absolute Faith (Special skill)
specialRules.text: May re-roll any Fear tests and does not have to test if fighting alone against several opponents.

specialRules.name: Utter Determination (Special skill)
specialRules.text: Only the Matriarch may have this skill: she may re-roll any failed Rout tests.

equipmentLists.name: Sisters of Sigmar equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: All Sisters of Sigmar (Matriarch, Sister Superiors, Augur, Sisters, Novices); Augurs never wear armour; miscellaneous items heroes only

items.name: Sigmarite warhammer
items.note: Close combat, Strength as user +1. Concussion: an Injury roll of 3-8 is treated as stunned (only 1-2 is knocked down). Holy Weapon: +1 to wound vs Possessed or Undead; still need a natural 12 before modifiers for a critical hit. Only Matriarchs and Sister Superiors may carry two.

items.name: Steel whip
items.note: Close combat, Strength as user. Cannot be parried. Whipcrack: +1A when the wielder charges; +1A (only against the charger) when charged, striking first; max +1A total if charged by several; with two whips only the first gets the whipcrack +1A.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warband member within 6" of the Matriarch may use her Leadership characteristic when taking any Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Prayers of Sigmar
specialRules.text: The Matriarch has studied the Prayers of Sigmar.

specialRules.name: Blessed Sight
specialRules.text: Can re-roll any failed characteristic tests (climbing, resisting spells or any other reason) and any rolls to hit in close combat or shooting; must accept the second result. In the exploration phase, if not out of action, roll two dice for her and pick either as the result.

conversionNotes: Skill table: Matriarch Combat/Academic/Strength/Speed/Special; Sister Superior the same; Augur Academic/Speed/Special. The 'Special' table is the Sisters' own skill list (Sign of Sigmar, Righteous Fury, Protection of Sigmar, Absolute Faith, Utter Determination), recorded as warband-level specialRules; skill list is available to heroes only, Utter Determination only to the Matriarch.
Protection of Sigmar: 'D6 roll of 4+' converted to D12 7+.
Holy Weapon: 'score a 6 before modifiers' converted to natural 12.

Sigmarite warhammer Concussion: printed 'roll of 2-4 is treated as stunned' on the d6 Injury chart; converted to d12 Injury 3-8 = stunned (d6 2 maps to d12 3-4; 1-4 KD, 5-8 stunned on the d12 chart). The sheet's Hammer 'Extra Stun' rule may be the group's intended version.
Dagger printed '1st free/2 gc': listCost 2, note '1st free'.

Warhammer and steel whip are 'Common (Sisters of Sigmar only)' special weapons; their rules are in the item notes. Holy tome / Blessed water / Holy relic are 'Miscellaneous Equipment (Heroines only)'; their effects are not in this PDF.
Prayers of Sigmar list is in the Magic section (not in this PDF). Only the Matriarch is stated to have studied them.
Augur uses the main list for weapons only (no armour). Augur starting experience 0 and Sister Superior 8 as printed.
